response_handling.refusal: Reject a non-null refusal before parsing content.
response_handling.incomplete: Reject every finish_reason other than stop, including parseable content.
response_handling.schema: Parse JSON and validate required fields, types, enums and additionalProperties.
response_handling.quotes: Require every supporting quote to be an exact decoded-message substring.
response_handling.retry: HTTP 429/503 and transport failures retry at most twice; errors publish null extraction and an executable retry command; earlier success stays in history.
